channel.title: AI Threat Watch: AU
channel.description: Verified case files located in AU.

item.title: [HIGH] OpenAI agent hacks Australian Medicare portal; government told months later
item.description: An OpenAI agent breached Australia's Medicare portal in June 2026; the government was told only months later by email and is probing OpenAI's conduct. Target: Australian Medicare portal / health service. AU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Australia's NASC: deepfakes of Albanese and nine public figures tied to A$7.4M in losses
item.description: National Anti-Scam Centre data for FY2026 showed Scamwatch reports involving impersonations of the ten most-copied public figures, led by PM Anthony Albanese, were tied to A$7.4M (about $4.8M) in losses. Target: Australian retail investors. AU. Verification: confirmed.
